author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Playtest Trailer for The Whisker Watch, an action roguelite developed by Catch the Void. Players will ensure the safety of their human by dispatching monsters from the Void. Acquire upgrades, attain loot, and join a friend in the chaos with co-op mode. The Whisker Watch is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a playtest running from October 29 through November 5.
title: The Whisker Watch - Official Playtest Trailer | Cozy After Dark Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Gameplay Trailer for The Road of Dust and Sorrow, a side-scrolling, story-driven game developed by Painted Black Games. Players will protect their daughter as a mother to survive the onslaught of creatures called Dusters. Solve puzzles and explore scenic locations in The Road of Dust and Sorrow, launching on December 3 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: The Road of Dust and Sorrow - Official Gameplay Trailer | Cozy After Dark Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out features from Hell is Other People in this latest trailer for the cute and disturbing psychological horror about identity, isolation, and the terrifying reality of being different. Hell is Other People will be available on PC.
title: Hell is Other People - Official Trailer | Cozy After Dark Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Hell Deck is a dark, twisted roguelike deckbuilder defense game. Here, the battlefield is a living, breathing, and volatile ecosystem where survival is bought with flesh. Force your units into a brutal cycle of predation and sacrifice, engineer a grotesque food chain, and repel the holy onslaught. Watch the Hell Deck launch trailer to see gameplay and more. Hell Deck is available now on PC.
title: Hell Deck - Official Launch Trailer | Cozy After Dark Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Launch Trailer for Welcome to Elderfield, a cozy horror RPG developed by Chris Cote. Players will manage the day-to-day operations of a farm with a spooky vibe by meeting the locals, decorating the home, and fighting creatures of the night. Welcome to Elderfield is available now on PC (Steam).
title: Welcome to Elderfield - Official Launch Trailer | Cozy After Dark Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Gameplay Trailer for Vale's Echo, a psychological horror 2D adventure game developed by Hollow Beak Games. Players will take on daunting puzzles in a realm where death is far from the end. Seek eternity in Vale's Echo, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Vale's Echo - Official Gameplay Trailer | Cozy After Dark Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Release Date Trailer for Usual June, a third-person action-adventure game developed by Finji. Players will seek the truth behind a city-wide mystery as monsters and ghosts occupy the streets. Fight back in Usual June, launching on January 20, 2027, for PC (Steam).
title: Usual June - Official Release Date Trailer | Cozy After Dark Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Release Date Trailer for UnderMire, a hand-drawn first-person roguelite developed by Table Knight Games. Players will take on enemies from biome to biome to cast spells, secure magical tools, and keep the fear gauge in check. UnderMire is launching on November 13 for PC (Steam).
title: UnderMire - Official Release Date Trailer | Cozy After Dark Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Launch Trailer for The Doll Shop, a hand-drawn, narrative-driven game developed by Atelier Sento. Players will live out the life of a young dollmaker in a story centered on love and horror as childhood friends reunite in a snow-covered village. The Doll Shop is available now for PC (Steam).
title: The Doll Shop - Official Launch Trailer | Cozy After Dark Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Gameplay Trailer for SPRKLS.exe, a melancholic story-driven puzzle platformer developed by PesiiDom. Players will experience a tale of friendship and misery as the apocalypse takes place on a mere desktop. Search for meaning in SPRKLS.exe, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: SPRKLS.exe - Official Gameplay Trailer | Cozy After Dark Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Official Trailer for Spanky Bat-a-Swing, a 3D rhythm-based platformer developed by Green Flamingo. Players will enter and explore Metronopolis, a city where everything and everyone moves and dances on the beat of music. Help Spanky the Bat teach Mayor Metrognome a lesson in Spanky Bat-a-Swing, coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
title: Spanky Bat-a-Swing - Official Trailer | Cozy After Dark Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Early Access Launch Trailer for Ritual Party, a multiplayer party game developed by Hologram Monster. Players will work together with friends to ensure wild rituals come to pass to permit cosmic horrors from entering the domain. Summon beings from the great beyond in Ritual Party, available now in Early Access for PC (Steam).
title: Ritual Party - Official Early Access Launch Trailer | Cozy After Dark Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Gameplay Trailer for Recollage, a story-rich adventure game developed by Studio Windspiel. Players will assemble paper collages to harness abilities and embark on an unsettling coming-of-age tale. Recollage is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Recollage - Official Gameplay Trailer | Cozy After Dark Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Kickstarter Trailer for Private Psychic, a narrative-driven investigation game developed by Pazazz! Players will embody Maple, who is building her own paranormal detective agency. Solve cases and navigate the trials of adult life in Private Psychic, coming soon to PC (Steam), with a Kickstarter available now to support the game's development.
title: Private Psychic - Official Kickstarter Trailer | Cozy After Dark Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Launch Trailer for Party on Hallow Grove, a pixel-based retro adventure game developed by Vaaasm. Players will converse with unique guests, explore a sprawling mansion, and decorate to create the scariest birthday party ever. Party on Hallow Grove is available now for PC (Steam).
title: Party on Hallow Grove - Official Launch Trailer | Cozy After Dark Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: In Mops & Mobs you are not the hero in the dungeon - you're the janitor helping the monsters. Mops & Mobs is a humorous dungeon adventure, spicing up storytelling with decoration quests and card-based battles. Befriend eccentric monsters and solve their problems. Clean, decorate, investigate, and eventually uncover dangers threatening the dungeon. Check out the Mops & Mobs trailer for a tour of the dungeon and meet your co-workers. Mops & Mobs will be available on PC in 2027.
title: Mops & Mobs - Official Trailer | Cozy After Dark Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out gameplay from Mona: The Endless Journey in this trailer for the 3D side-scrolling Metroidvania. You play as a fragile, pillow-carrying girl, adventuring in a nightmarish fantasy continent. Rescue powerful companions, traverse mysteries, solve puzzles, fight eerie creatures, and uncover the world’s hidden truth. Mona: The Endless Journey will be available on PC.
title: Mona: The Endless Journey - Official Gameplay Trailer | Cozy After Dark Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Run the Eastern Underworld in this cozy city-builder simulation! Design land layout, hire quirky soulkeepers, and punish sinful souls. Give souls a place to call home. Encounter legends from myths, explore worlds above... Take another look at Hundred Nights: DIFU in this latest trailer ahead of the game's launch on PC.
title: Hundred Nights: DIFU - Official Trailer | Cozy After Dark Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out Hino in this trailer for the upcoming 2D dark fantasy adventure in which Hino, a girl with a red ribbon, and a small white "Moni-Moni Skeleton" journey through a world of darkness. Having lost her memories, Hino sets out across a monster-infested land in search of a place of peace. As she travels deeper, the truth behind the world of darkness begins to unfold. Join Hino and the Moni-Moni Skeleton on a perilous journey toward a place where they can finally rest. Hino will be available on PC and Nintendo Switch in 2027.
title: Hino - Official Trailer | Cozy After Dark Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Fallbearers is a co-op dark-humor simulation where you and a colleague transport the deceased, grappling with volatile ragdoll physics, changing terrain, and pesky obstacles in the Victorian streets. Please ensure the client arrives in one piece (we certainly won't). Fallbearers will be available on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Fallbearers - Official Demo Trailer | Cozy After Dark Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: DeadRoot is a barbaric medieval action-adventure set in a bug-sized world of underground dungeons and towering ruins. Splatter bug guts and slay colossal bosses as Kitt, a lone snail warrior, who must draw his sword against overwhelming odds. Get a fresh look at DeadRoot in this new trailer for the upcoming action-adventure game. DeadRoot will be available on Xbox Series X/S and Steam.
title: DeadRoot - Official Gameplay Trailer | Cozy After Dark Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out gameplay and more from Catechesis in this trailer for the upcoming horror RPG. Embrace the darkness as a demon-possessed altar boy in Catechesis. Explore the city, battle demons, upgrade your weapons, and embark on an unforgettable journey with unique characters and anime-style cutscenes. Catechesis will be available on PC in 2027. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Catechesis - Official Trailer | Cozy After Dark Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at puzzles and the world of Cages: Hidden Worlds in this trailer for the upcoming first-person puzzle escape game set in a mansion that holds the remains of a freak show carnival. Meet the former stars of the show, now locked inside intricate contraptions. Venture into surreal worlds lurking between the cracks of reality and solve the workings of complex original machinery. Cages: Hidden Worlds will be available on PC in Q1 2027.
title: Cages: Hidden Worlds - Official Trailer | Cozy After Dark Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the trailer for Adopt Me Please, an upcoming cozy horror pet adoption sim about spotting impostors. Adopt Me Please will be available on Steam and Nintendo Switch in 2027.
title: Adopt Me Please - Official Announcement Trailer | Cozy After Dark Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Gretel & Hansel is a fully hand-painted watercolor horror-adventure in which Gretel must guide her brother through a cursed forest, outwit deadly traps, solve sinister puzzles, and escape a ravenous witch. Originally released in 2009 and 2010, Gretel & Hansel has been fully reimagined and expanded with Part 3. Gretel & Hansel will be available on PC.
title: Gretel & Hansel - Official Trailer | Cozy After Dark Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Build up your castle in this roguelike twist on the block-dropping puzzler! Place your rooms strategically to reach greater heights. Will you be able to build a fortress to stand the test of time, or will that pesky hero send your work crumbling to the ground? Check out the latest Draftula trailer. Draftula will be available on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Draftula - Official Trailer | Cozy After Dark Showcase 2026
